title: Prompt caching on Anthropic's Messages API: the stable prefix cached, a conversation under way at its end, every cached token priced and kept
request: After the UI, implement prompt caching using platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching.
plan: Mark the last tool and the system prompt for the cache on every request.
Add the automatic breakpoint only to a conversation under way.
Read the reply's cache reads and writes, price them at their own rates, keep them in the usage log and the request's event.
Keep the estimate before sending an upper bound; one switch and one time to live for the process.

decisions.decision: The moving (automatic) breakpoint only when the conversation has an assistant turn.
decisions.why: A single request with a new question would pay 1.25 to 2 times the input price to write text no request reads again.

decisions.decision: Five minutes by default, an hour by DCLAB_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL; a misspelt TTL is refused.
decisions.why: The hour costs 2 times to write; a silent fallback would change every request's cost.

decisions.decision: input_tokens keeps counting every input token; the cache's share is said apart.
decisions.why: The caps, totals and pages read input_tokens; the price applies each share's rate.

decisions.decision: The estimate multiplies the input by the write rate when the cache is on.
decisions.why: The reservation before sending must stay an upper bound, or a cap could be passed.

change: models/anthropic_client.py (breakpoints, usage), models/prices.py (cache_read rate per model, CACHE_WRITE, caching(), cost and estimate), models/gateway.py and usage.py (cache tokens priced and kept), storage migration 0020 (model_request.cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens), dclab_core experience_event v12 (model.request's cache tokens; dclab-core 0.100.0).

findings.defect: The transport's tests read the system prompt as a string.
findings.cause: The system prompt is now a block carrying its cache mark.
findings.fix: The tests read its text from the block; the mark is tested in test_prompt_cache.

findings.defect: The event vocabulary changed shape under the same version.
findings.fix: experience_event v12, v11 read as v12.

measurements.name: prompt caching live with Sonnet 5.5
measurements.gate: a second request with the same prefix reads it from the cache and costs less than the first
measurements.result: the first wrote 2,185 tokens (EUR 0.00606); the second read 2,185 (EUR 0.00079, about 87 percent less); a conversation under way read 2,185 and wrote 35 at its end; EUR 0.008 in all
limits: three requests from one workspace; the saving on real traffic depends on how often a purpose repeats within five minutes

outcome: Every Anthropic request caches its stable prefix and every cached token is priced and recorded; a repeated prompt costs about a seventh.
lessons: Check a provider feature live once: the tests prove the request's shape, only the API proves it caches.
risks: A prompt below 512 tokens (Sonnet 5.5) is not cached and costs as before.
